title: Volunteer Toolkits | Earth Day
metaDescription: Use our volunteer toolkits to learn how to get involved with climate action and become an environmental advocate. Every day is Earth Day!
paragraphs: Knowledge is key to making an impact. Check out the volunteer toolkits below to learn how anyone can help solve some of the world’s most pressing issues.
“We need to build a global citizenry fluent in the concept of climate change and inspired by environmental education to act in defense of the planet.”
